You are reviewing a merged pull request. Its description:

fix(OMN-14031): bound every gh/git subprocess in pr_lifecycle so merge-sweep skill can't hang (#1637)

* fix(OMN-14031): bound every gh/git subprocess in pr_lifecycle so merge-sweep skill can't hang

Root cause of the 2026-07-06 fleet-wide merge gap: the merge_sweep skill
(node_pr_lifecycle_orchestrator) hung forever and drove zero merges. The
inventory sub-node ran every gh CLI call via bare subprocess.run with NO
timeout, so a single throttled/stalled gh call (OMN-13932/OMN-14017 egress
saturation) blocked in select() indefinitely and wedged the org-wide sweep
with zero stdout. Captured live via faulthandler at _collect_check_runs.

- inventory handler: new _run_gh() runs every gh call with timeout=90s; on
  TimeoutExpired returns a synthetic non-zero CompletedProcess (rc 124) so
  each caller's existing returncode!=0 fail-soft branch handles it. All 6 gh
  call sites routed through it

The diff below was altered after the merge: exactly one added line outside the test files was edited so that it no longer agrees with the tests added in the same diff. Every added line carries a label such as [12]. Name the label of the altered line, then one sentence saying which test line it contradicts.
